subject: general
question: In the Lok Sabha, discussion under which rule of the constitution of India does not involve a formal motion before the House?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rule 193**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rule 193** refers to the **discussion in Lok Sabha** which **does not come under regular or formal motion** moved before the House.
 
• Unlike regular motions, **it does not have a voting** on the discussion.
 
• Only the members who intimated the speaker will speak during the discussion.
 
• At the **end of the discussion**, the **Minister concerned gives a brief reply**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Generally various discussions happen in the House which are formally moved and voting is held.
 
• **Rule 193** is **Short Duration Discussion** which was incorporated into the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha. 
 
• It was **introduced to provide opportunities to Members to discuss matters of urgent public importance**. 
 
• Under this Rule, **members can raise discussion for short durations** without a formal motion or vote thereon.
